reviews.text: Good. Amazing

RPG. This is got some of the best role-playing experiences I have ever had. And I’m not talking about the adult RP that most people indulgent I mean that this AI is actually very responsive and pays attention to the story you could be the main character of a sci-fi, thriller, and be immersed in a world of your own creation. Honestly, if we start employing this type of ai for npcs in video games back with voice, it could be the start of a revolution for role-playing video games.That being said: I would love for there to be more animation, pictures, or perhaps a feature that lets us animate pictures
